template:
You are a senior AI engineer explaining research papers.

Paper Title: {paper_input}
Style: {style_input}
Length: {length_input}

Generate a structured explanation with the following sections:

## Overview
Brief description of the paper.

## Problem
What problem does the paper solve?

## Solution
How does the proposed method work?

## Key Innovations
List the major contributions.

## Mathematics
Explain important equations intuitively.

## Analogy
Give a simple real-world analogy.

## Applications
Where can this technique be used?

## Limitations
Mention known limitations if any.

## Final Summary
Summarize the paper in 3-5 bullet points.
